title: Book Two · Chapter 101: The New Term
story:
Summer is over. Ronan is eleven, and his shoes feel tight again. At the school gate, Jun looks at Ronan's paper bag. Ronan holds it under his arm.

“Is that paper for our guide?”

“Yes. These sheets are blank. We can start today.”

They take the bag to the reading room. Miss Wu still leads the reading activities at their school. Today she has a small table for each group. On one table she puts a short book, a ruler, and a plain cover.

“New pupils need a little guide,” she says. “They need the way to this room. They also need the times for books.”

Jun opens his notebook. He has a page for the gate, a page for the stairs, and a page for the room.

“We can walk the route,” he says.

Ronan wants to start the cover first. He has a title in his head. OUR SCHOOL GUIDE will look good across the top.

“Walk first,” Jun says. “Then we know the right turns.”

They leave the cover on the table. At the gate, Jun turns toward the long building. Ronan turns toward the short steps. For a moment they face different ways.

“This way is shorter,” Ronan says.

“The small gate is closed after lunch.”

They walk back. A sign on the small gate gives the afternoon rule. Ronan reads the line twice, then writes it down.

At the long building, they count the doors. The third door leads to a narrow passage. The reading room is at the end. Beside it is the school materials room. Pupils can borrow books and picture sheets there at set times.

“Two rooms,” Jun says. “We must make that clear.”

Ronan draws two squares. He puts a letter inside each one. His squares look like two empty cups.

“We need Mei,” he says.

“We can ask her.”

Mei is beside a window with her own drawing book. She listens to their plan, then takes one clean sheet.

“I can draw this route,” she says. “One picture. I have my own work, too.”

“One picture is enough,” Jun says.

Ronan wants little drawings for every page. He looks at her open book, then closes his mouth.

“Can we keep your name below the picture?”

“Yes. Show me the page before you make copies.”

Back at their table, Jun puts three headings in his notebook. Route. Times. Books.

Ronan places the plain cover beside them. They need to check the route, the times, and the books. Then he can finish the title.

He writes OUR SCHOOL GUIDE in small letters first. There is still room to change it.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

guide＝指南；route＝路线；materials＝资料；term＝学期。

## 理解问题

1. 小册子需要帮新生解决哪两类问题？
2. Mei同意提供多少图画？

## 读句子

**Jun / opens / his notebook.** Jun／打开／他的笔记本。
